source.artifact_note: Observed public revision; it postdates paper v1 and is not an exact build of the paper.

dataset.record_shape: Redis STRING key/value records with the source production shape; exact production snapshots and keys are not public.

logical_identity: normalized key/value records; the exact source normalization is unknown

G1.note: A value update is one logical mutation but d_ms = 2 under multiset semantics.

completion_boundary: difference IDs resolved; repair application excluded

scale.smoke: scale-down is allowed only as a smoke test while preserving record shape
scale.reporting: smoke results must be reported separately from source-scale results

tuning_evaluation.tuning: comparative implementation and tuning are deferred; do not tune against G1/G2 outcomes
tuning_evaluation.evaluation: G1 and G2 are the frozen evaluation regimes

hypothesis: For the addon/scan case, scan and normalization cost will dominate at low d, so network savings will not necessarily translate into equivalent wall-clock savings.
unknown_policy: Unknown stays unknown; never coerce an unspecified field to zero.
